user.title: Halo TV
user.description: The address of the TV's own web server - the one the phone remote opens at http://<tv-ip>:8765. Halo TV must be installed on the TV and the TV must be awake.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.42, or the whole http://192.168.1.42:8765 address.
data_description.name: What this TV is called in Home Assistant. Leave it empty to use the TV's model.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Check the address, that Halo TV is running on it, and that both are on the same network.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

command.name: Send a command
command.description: Tell a Halo TV to do one thing: pause, go dark, open Ambient, read something out loud.

action.name: Command
action.description: pause, play, play_pause, stop, next, prev, screen_off, screen_on, screen_toggle, home, ambient, dismiss, say, stop_speech, volume_set, volume_up, volume_down, mute or unmute.

text.name: Text
text.description: For 'say': the words to read out.

message.name: Message
message.description: For 'notify': the line of text to show.

title.name: Title
title.description: For 'notify': the small heading above the message.

image.name: Image
image.description: For 'notify': a picture to show, as an http(s) address or a data: URI.

language.name: Language
language.description: For 'say' and a spoken 'notify': a tag like en-GB or zh-CN. Empty uses the TV's own language.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: For 'notify': seconds on screen. 0 leaves it up until dismissed.

level.name: Volume level
level.description: For 'volume_set': 0-1, the way Home Assistant usually means volume.
